name: Yaken Rodem
storyline: A dog named Rodem is abandoned at the park by its master. Rodem is then forced to survive in the park.
summary: Rodem is a stray dog who lives in Hyakujiri Park, a big park in the suburbs. You will be able to live his life, and how you live your life as Rodem is up to you. Eat when hungry. Mark your territory. Sometimes there will be fights with other dogs and animals, and sometimes there are heartwarming interactions with humans... This is a self-service emotional movie, one that you can direct yourself.
